senses.definition: litigation shown to have been instituted maliciously and without probable cause
examples: he got an injunction against vexatious litigation by his enemies

senses.definition: in a vexatious manner
troubled persistently especially with petty annoyances
examples: her poor pestered father had to endure her constant interruptions
the vexed parents of an unruly teenager

senses.definition: causing difficulty in finding an answer or solution; much disputed
examples: we live in vexed and troubled times

senses.definition: someone given to teasing (as by mocking or stirring curiosity)
extremely annoying or displeasing
examples: his cavalier curtness of manner was exasperating
the ceaseless tumult of the jukebox was maddening

senses.definition: causing irritation or annoyance
examples: tapping an annoying rhythm on his glass with his fork
aircraft noise is particularly bothersome near the airport
